summary.text:
Global markets face headwinds from slowing economic activity in China, where October industrial output and retail sales missed expectations, alongside Japan's unexpected third-quarter economic contraction. Equities were mixed to lower, with the Nasdaq dropping 1.22% and Nvidia sliding 2.01%, while the Dow gained 0.10% and the Nikkei 225 fell 1.57%.

The dollar index was flat at 103.449, with the euro falling 0.24% to 1.1024. In commodities, Brent remained at 95.01 and WTI stood at 88.01. Gold held at 3889.0, dropping below 3,900 dollars amid intensifying bets on a December Federal Reserve interest rate hike. Bitcoin rose 1.3% to 64963.0391.

Attention shifts to upcoming Nvidia earnings alongside high-stakes diplomacy, specifically the planned United States, China, and Russia trilateral summit scheduled for November 19 in Shenzhen featuring Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin.
